text: This presentation provides an overview of the City of Toronto’s newly created Development Review division, outlining its role in expediting development applications. It highlights the division’s organizational structure, key mandates, and recent efforts to strengthen collaboration with school boards, particularly through regular engagement with the Toronto Catholic District School Board to support timely project delivery and shared accountability. The presentation also includes a status update on active school board development applications.
The City-School Boards Advisory Committee received the item for information.
